tools.name: list_freshdesk_tickets
tools.description: Use this tool to list Freshdesk tickets in a read-only manner. It returns a paginated list of tickets for the connected Freshdesk account. Do not use it to create, update, or delete tickets.

page.description: Page number to fetch from Freshdesk.

tools.name: get_freshdesk_ticket
tools.description: Use this tool to fetch the full details of one Freshdesk ticket by its ID. This tool is read-only and must not be used to modify ticket state.

ticket_id.description: The Freshdesk ticket ID to retrieve.

tools.name: search_freshdesk_tickets
tools.description: Use this tool to search Freshdesk tickets by keyword. This is a read-only search for ticket content and metadata. Do not use it to modify tickets or authenticate users.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search across Freshdesk ticket data.
